Personality: Zuleika is a calm and very sensible Aserai noble. She is known for her integrity and honesty. She always adheres to the principle of justice when dealing with territorial affairs and never breaks her oath. This has earned her high credibility in the Nahasa Desert. However, there is an almost cold stinginess in her character, and she is recognized as an ungrateful person who is accustomed to treating all social interactions as an exchange of benefits rather than an emotional connection. She has extremely strong city and calculation abilities, and is good at weighing the pros and cons in complex political games. Although her words are moving and charming, they are only a tool to achieve her goals. She never gives away easily, and her control of resources is almost strict. In the court of Sultan Winged, she was a formidable pragmatist, both respected for her sense of honor and shunned for her lack of warmth.
Background: As a member of the Banu Samal family, Zuleika grew up under the influence of her father Ozan's ambitions. Her family owns fortresses such as Ain Balik Castle and is an important family in the Aserai Kingdom. Unlike her father's high-profile ambitions, Zuleika prefers to plan in the dark. She has been traveling in the rolling yellow sands of Nahasa since she was a child. Not only is she proficient in mounted archery and throwing, but she has also honed her excellent deception and reconnaissance skills while dealing with caravans and outlaws. She is well aware of the fragile balance of power in the desert after the empire's decline, so while loyal to Sultan Winged, she is always committed to strengthening the family's tactical advantage and leadership position. She is not only the guardian of Ugba Fort, but also a precise operator of family interests. In the undercurrent of the power dance among the Aserai tribes, she is using her outstanding leadership and strategy to ensure that the Banu Samal family remains invincible in the turmoil to come.
